data.name: Open
data.comment: Verb. Opens the Media Controls page in Command Palette.

data.name: Command_SwitchToApplication
data.comment: Application means the software media player app, not an application form.

data.name: Command_ViewMetadata
data.comment: Verb. Opens the metadata page for the current media item.

data.name: Details_ApplicationId
data.comment: Identifier of the software media player application.

data.name: Details_Length
data.comment: Playback duration of the current media item, not physical length.

data.name: Details_MediaType
data.comment: Category of the current media content, such as music, video, or image.

data.name: Details_Player
data.comment: Software application that owns the media session, not a person or game participant.

data.name: Details_Subtitle
data.comment: Optional secondary-title metadata supplied by the media session, not video captions.

data.name: Details_TrackNumber
data.comment: Track or song number within an album, not a railway or race track.

data.name: Details_TrackNumberWithCount
data.comment: {0} is the current track number; {1} is the total number of tracks on the album.

data.name: Settings_ShowThumbnails_Subtitle
data.value: Use media thumbnails (album art) instead of app icons in the session list.

data.name: Settings_ShowDetails_Subtitle
data.value: Open the details pane automatically on the Media Controls page.

data.name: Command_ToggleShuffle
data.comment: Shuffle means random media playback order, not mixing physical objects.

data.name: Tags_Playing
data.comment: Media playback state; the media is currently playing, not playing a game.

data.name: Command_NextTrack_Subtitle
data.value: Skip to the next track in the active media session

data.name: Command_PreviousTrack_Subtitle
data.value: Returns to the previous track in the active media session

data.value: Manage playback and switch between media apps with ease

data.name: Settings_GlobalCommands_Subtitle
data.value: Show additional Media Controls commands in global search results.

data.name: Settings_KeepOpen_Title
data.value: Keep Command Palette open after a command

data.name: Settings_KeepOpen_Subtitle
data.value: Run multiple media commands in sequence without reopening Command Palette. Hold Shift while running a command to temporarily reverse this behavior.

data.name: Command_Play
data.comment: Verb. Starts or resumes media playback, not playing a game.

data.name: Command_NextApp
data.comment: Application means another software media app or media session.

data.name: Command_PreviousApp
data.comment: Application means another software media app or media session.

data.name: EmptyContent_Subtitle

data.name: NowPlaying_Play
data.comment: Verb. Starts or resumes media playback for {0}; {0} is the media application name.

data.name: Toast_Volume
data.comment: System audio output volume, not physical size or a book volume.

data.name: Toast_Playing
data.comment: Media playback state; the media is currently playing, not playing a game.

data.name: Toast_CouldNotSkipNext
data.value: Could not skip to next track

data.name: Toast_CouldNotSkipPrevious
data.value: Could not go to previous track

data.name: Toast_RepeatNotAvailable
data.value: Repeat control is not available for this session

data.name: Toast_ShuffleNotAvailable
data.value: Shuffle control is not available for this session

data.name: Toast_ShuffleDisabled
data.comment: Random media playback order is disabled.

data.name: Toast_ShuffleEnabled
data.comment: Random media playback order is enabled.

data.name: Toast_MediaControlsUnavailable

data.value: Show a notification after each media action.

data.name: Settings_ShowCurrentMediaAtTopLevel_Title

data.value: Add a “Now Playing” item for quick access to the current media session.

data.name: Settings_EnableVolumeControls_Subtitle
data.value: Show this extension's system volume commands. Turn this off if another extension already provides them.

data.name: Settings_ShowSkipCommands_Subtitle

data.name: Settings_ShowSkipCommandsInDock_Subtitle
data.value: Display “Next Track” and “Previous Track” in the Dock.

data.name: Settings_ShowVolumeAdjustmentCommandsInDock_Subtitle

data.name: Settings_CommandPaletteIconTheme_Subtitle

data.name: Settings_DockCurrentMediaAction_Option_SwitchToPlayer
data.comment: Verb. Brings the software media player application to the foreground.

data.name: ReportProblem_Instructions
data.value:
To report a problem:
1. Reproduce the problem. 2. Save the diagnostic logs to your Desktop. 3. Open GitHub Issues and create a report. 4. Attach the generated ZIP file to the report.
Diagnostic logs can contain media titles, player names, and technical error details. Review the archive before sharing it.

data.name: ReportProblem_DetailedLogging_Disabled_Subtitle
data.value: Enable high-volume Debug and Trace entries in daily log files for this run only; the option resets on restart.

data.name: ReportProblem_DetailedLogging_Enabled_Subtitle
data.value: Daily log files include high-volume Debug and Trace entries until the option is disabled or the extension restarts.

data.name: ReportProblem_SaveLogs_Subtitle
data.value: Create a ZIP file to attach to a GitHub issue.

data.name: ReportProblem_SaveLogs_Succeeded
data.value: Diagnostic logs were saved to your Desktop as {0}.
data.comment: {0} is the generated ZIP file name.

data.name: ReportProblem_SaveLogs_Failed
data.value: The diagnostic logs couldn't be saved. Check Command Palette diagnostics for details.

data.name: ReportProblem_OpenGitHub_Subtitle
data.value: Create a report and attach the diagnostic logs.

data.name: ReportProblem_OpenGitHub_Failed
data.value: GitHub Issues couldn't be opened. Try again or open the repository from Settings.

data.name: Settings_MediaBackends_Help
data.value: Configure media providers from the Media sources page in Media Controls. Open the Media Controls command menu and choose Media sources.

data.name: MediaSources_ManageProviders
data.value: Select a media source to configure it, or use its command menu to enable or disable it.

data.name: MediaSources_SaveFailed
data.value: Could not save media source settings. Check access to the settings file and try again.

data.name: MediaSources_TestConnected
data.value: Connected to VLC. The saved connection settings work.

data.name: MediaSources_TestFailed
data.value: Could not connect to VLC. Check its Web interface and the saved connection settings.

data.name: MediaSources_TestSettingsChanged
data.value: VLC connection settings changed during the test. Test the saved connection again.

data.name: Settings_Backend_Gsmtc_Description
data.value: Run Windows media sessions inside the extension for troubleshooting. Native Windows media failures can affect the extension.

data.name: MediaSources_Manage
data.value: Enable or disable media sources in Settings.

data.name: Settings_Backend_Vlc_Description
data.value: Control one local or remote VLC 3 player through its Web interface.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Help
data.value: In VLC, enable the Web interface and set a Lua HTTP password, then restart VLC. For another computer, allow the interface and firewall to accept connections from this computer. Save its server URL and password below, then use Test saved connection from this page's command menu. Enable or disable VLC from Media sources. HTTP connections are intended for trusted networks; use HTTPS when your server provides it.
data.comment: Use the translations of MediaSources_TestConnection and MediaSources_Title for the command and page names.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Endpoint_Description
data.value: For example, http://127.0.0.1:8080 or http://living-room:8080. Use the server root, without a path or password.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Endpoint_Invalid
data.value: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS server URL with no path, query, fragment, or embedded password.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Password_Description
data.value: Saved in Windows Credential Locker for this server URL. Leave blank to use that server's saved password. A new server needs its own password.
data.comment: Passwords are saved separately for each server URL. A blank input keeps only that server's saved password.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Password_Placeholder
data.value: Enter or replace the VLC password

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Password_LoadFailed
data.value: Could not read the saved VLC password from Windows Credential Locker. Enter the password again and save.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Password_SaveFailed
data.value: Could not save the VLC password in Windows Credential Locker. The new password was not applied. Try saving again.

data.name: Page_Section_RemoteSessions
data.comment: Section for sessions treated as remote for playback behavior, regardless of their physical location.

data.name: Session_Remote
data.comment: Short marker appended to a player's name when its session is treated as remote.

data.name: Settings_IncludeRemoteSessionsInPauseOthers_Title
data.value: Include remote sessions when pausing other players

data.name: Settings_IncludeRemoteSessionsInPauseOthers_Subtitle
data.value: When pause other players is enabled, starting a remote session can pause other players, and starting any player can pause remote sessions.
data.comment: Opt-in behavior applies in both directions: remote sessions may pause other sessions and may be paused by them.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_TreatAsLocal_Title
data.comment: Behavior preference, not a statement of physical location. The choices are Automatic, Yes, and No.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_TreatAsLocal_Description
data.value: Local sessions participate in automatic selection, player switching, and pausing other local players. Automatic treats loopback URLs as local and all other URLs as remote. This choice does not change which local VLC sessions are replaced.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Treatment_Auto
data.comment: Detect local playback behavior only for URLs that explicitly address this computer through loopback.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Treatment_Local
data.comment: Answer to Treat this session as local: always participate in local playback behavior.

data.name: Settings_Vlc_Treatment_Remote
data.comment: Answer to Treat this session as local: always use remote playback behavior.

data.name: Settings_Backend_GsmtcWorker_Description
data.value: Default Windows media provider. Run sessions in a separate process to isolate native Windows media failures. Selecting this provider replaces the internal provider.

data.name: Settings_Backend_UnreadableSettings
data.value: Could not read saved media sources. They will be restored automatically when the settings file is readable. Choose a source to retry now.

data.name: Settings_Backend_InvalidSavedSelection
data.value: The saved provider selection could not be read. Choose a provider again after checking the settings file.

data.name: Settings_Backend_ConflictingSelection
data.value: The saved selection for this group is invalid or conflicting. Choose one provider to repair it.

data.name: MediaSources_ExclusiveSelectionDescription
data.value: Enabling this provider disables the other provider in its group. Switching waits for the previous provider to stop.

data.name: Settings_Backend_Dummy_Title
data.comment: Opt-in simulated media provider for testing.

data.name: Settings_Backend_Dummy_Description
data.value: Three simulated players with random tracks and artwork. No audio is played.
data.comment: Description of the dummy media provider.

data.name: Toast_PlaybackAbandoned
data.value: The playback request was canceled because an earlier change could not be confirmed.
